# #26 Library + multi-file sessions — blind QA report

**Verdict: PASS.** No blocker or major defects. There are 3 minor and 2 cosmetic findings.

**How this was tested:** a throwaway `scripts/lib/stack.sh run` stack (prod build of the worktree as of about 02:27Z), driven by Chromium through `scripts/lib/browser-slot.sh`, one browser at a time. The drivers are in `.verify/qa/26/*.mjs` (`api.mjs`, `main.mjs`, `files.mjs`, `files2.mjs`, `big.mjs`, `themes.mjs`) and the screenshots are in `.verify/qa/26/qa-*.png`. I did not read any `src/` code or the diff. Tracked files were not edited.

## Edge cases
- **FTS syntax:** `" * - OR NEAR( "unbalanced a:b ^x () AND OR NOT 😀 café` all return 200 from the API. In the UI none of them showed `library-error`. PASS.
- **café tag:** rejected by both the API (400 with the same message) and the UI (`library-tag-error`). An emoji collection name gets the id as its slug, and colliding slugs get `-2`/`-3` suffixes. PASS.
- **Case-only collection rename:** "Alpha Coll" → "ALPHA COLL" is allowed, and renaming another collection to "ops" gives 409. PASS.
- **Deleting the collection being filtered on:** the URL falls back to `/library`. PASS.
- **Pin, then delete the doc elsewhere:** no dead row in the pinned section. PASS.
- **Recent entry for a doc deleted elsewhere:** see m3 below.
- **Select all across 600 rows, then change a filter:** the bar read "600 selected" and was hidden after the filter change. PASS.
- **Pin limit:** with 50 pins, the 51st click shows the toast "Pin limit reached (50) — unpin a document first", nothing changes, and `aria-pressed` stays false. PASS.
- **Odd file names:** `src/a b.md`, `q#x.md`, `what?.md`, `100%.md`, `café/ü.md`, `@x.md`, `edit.md` and `notes.txt` all open by tab and survive a reload. Their URLs encode correctly (`%20`, `%23`, `%3F`, `%25`, `caf%C3%A9/%C3%BC.md`, `%40x.md`). PASS.
- **File route behaviour:** `?view=edit` on a file route is forced to `view=read` with no editor. `#tail` inside a file behaves the same as on the primary doc. Rapid back ×3 / forward ×2 ends consistent: the URL matches the selected tab. Pinned revision `/d/x@1` hides tabs and attachments. A file added by another client appears in the tab strip without a reload. A failed upload shows an error toast and adds no tab. PASS.
- **HTML file with a script:** the script runs inside the iframe, which has no `allow-same-origin`. The parent title was untouched. PASS.
- **Phone with 500+ docs:** 600 reachable with at most 33 rows in the DOM, and no long tasks during scrolling. The phone breadcrumb is one line ("Library … Main report v2 @x.md", 26 px tall). The tablet (820) layout has no horizontal scroll. PASS.
- **Keyboard only:**
  - Tab order runs header → search → sort → filters.
  - Typing a search works and Esc clears it; arrowing the sort select updates the URL.
  - The AppMenu opens with focus on the first menuitem, and Esc returns focus to the trigger.
  - Delete → confirm dialog traps focus; Esc closes it, the collection is kept, and focus returns to the trigger.
  - "+ New" collection works by keyboard.
  - The phone filters sheet takes focus when opened and returns it to the toggle on Esc.
  - All PASS.
- **Themes:** all 6 themes (light, dark, github-light, github-dark, locus-light, locus-dark) checked on the library page with a search and on the file strip/breadcrumb (`qa-theme-<t>-library.png`, `qa-theme-<t>-files.png`). The text is legible, and the hits and badges use theme tokens.
- **URL state:** back, forward and reload restore `mode`/`type` in both the URL and the controls. PASS.

## Defects
1. **m1 (minor) — file remove/replace use native `window.confirm()`.**
   - Repro: as an editor, click `file-tab-remove`, or add a file whose name already exists.
   - The browser shows a native dialog: "Remove “notes.md” from this document? This cannot be undone." / "“appendix.md” is already part of this document. Replace it?"
   - The library uses the in-app `library-confirm-dialog`, so this is inconsistent. Native dialogs also get suppressed in some embedded contexts.
2. **m2 (minor) — choosing the default sort writes it into the URL.**
   - Repro: pick sort "Title", then "Recently updated". The URL keeps `sort=updated`.
   - Later typing a q stays on `updated` instead of switching to the default `relevance`, and the "bare URL" state is lost.
   - Rule 5 holds only when the sort was never touched.
3. **m3 (minor) — opening a recent entry for a doc deleted elsewhere shows the local copy.**
   - Repro: view a doc, delete it via the API, then click its `library-recent-item`.
   - The URL becomes `/` and the page shows "This shared session no longer exists. Showing your local copy" instead of a not-found state.
   - This comes from the pre-existing local-copy fallback, but it does not match the spec's edge-case wording.
   - Screenshot: qa-recent-deleted.png.
4. **c1 (cosmetic) — phone cards are fixed-height and leave about 80 px of empty space.**
   - The blank band sits under the badges line on cards without tags.
   - Screenshot: qa-phone-library.png.
5. **c2 (cosmetic) — the phone header clips "Set your name".**
   - The `reviewer-name` button is truncated against the theme buttons.
   - Screenshot: qa-phone-library.png.

**Notes, not defects:**
- An error toast's text appears twice in `[role=alert]` queries, likely the toast plus a live-region duplicate. It is visually fine.
- `limit=0` and `limit=101` are clamped rather than rejected with 400. The spec does not require a 400 there.
